related.title: 科學級 CCD 成像系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「為何紅外偵測器必須低溫：能隙與熱激發」與「讀出模式：CDS、Fowler 與 up-the-ramp」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；科學級 CCD 成像系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Why infrared detectors must be cold: bandgap and thermal excitation" and "Readout modes: CDS, Fowler and up-the-ramp" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Scientific CCD imaging systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦HgCdTe 混成陣列的截止波長、暗電流、多次取樣讀出與低溫特性化工程；科學級 CCD 成像系統則以背照式量子效率、電荷轉移效率、輸出放大器讀出雜訊、深冷暗電流與光子轉移增益校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cutoff wavelength, dark current, multi-sample readout and cryogenic characterisation of HgCdTe hybrid arrays; Scientific CCD imaging systems centres on back-illuminated QE, charge-transfer efficiency, output-amplifier read noise, deep-cooled dark current and photon-transfer gain calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「窄能隙半導體與截止波長」與「背照式矽吸收層」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到科學級 CCD 成像系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「光子轉移曲線與 Fe-55 增益校正」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Narrow-gap semiconductor and cutoff wavelength” and “Back-illuminated silicon absorber”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Scientific CCD imaging systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Photon transfer curve and Fe-55 gain calibration", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 低溫紅外偵測器
history.text: HgCdTe 於 1959 年由 Lawson 等人首次合成，1980 年代 Rockwell 與 Santa Barbara Research Center 等公司把它做成銦凸塊混成陣列，1990 年代的 NICMOS（256²）與 HAWAII（1024²）陣列讓哈伯太空望遠鏡與地面望遠鏡進入近紅外巡天時代。2000 年代 Rockwell Scientific（後併入 Teledyne）為 JWST 發展 2048² 的 HAWAII-2RG 與 SIDECAR ASIC，JWST 的 NIRCam、NIRSpec 與 FGS 共使用 15 塊；地面上 VISTA 的 VIRCAM 以 16 塊 2048² 陣列巡天，歐幾里得衛星的 NISP 於 2023 年以 16 塊 H2RG 升空，Roman 太空望遠鏡則採用 18 塊 4096² 的 H4RG。
history.textEn: HgCdTe was first synthesised by Lawson and colleagues in 1959, in the 1980s Rockwell, the Santa Barbara Research Center and others turned it into indium-bump hybrid arrays, and the NICMOS (256²) and HAWAII (1024²) arrays of the 1990s opened the near-infrared survey era for the Hubble Space Telescope and ground-based observatories. In the 2000s Rockwell Scientific, later part of Teledyne, developed the 2048² HAWAII-2RG and the SIDECAR ASIC for JWST, whose NIRCam, NIRSpec and FGS use 15 of them; on the ground VISTA's VIRCAM surveys with 16 2048² arrays, the Euclid NISP instrument launched in 2023 with 16 H2RGs, and the Roman Space Telescope carries 18 4096² H4RGs.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「為何紅外偵測器必須低溫：能隙與熱激發」到「偵測器特性化、操作點選擇與交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Why infrared detectors must be cold: bandgap and thermal excitation" through "Detector characterisation, operating-point choice and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
